title: Envs-FORGE: Frontier-Optimized Reward-Grounded Environment Synthesis for Agent RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.14312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for terminal agents needs executable training environments with reliable rewards and useful difficulty. Fixed recipes such as few-shot, Self-Instruct, and Evol-Instruct apply the same prompting policy to every seed, even when the current policy would benefit from a harder, easier, or simply different task. We present Envs-FORGE, a prompting policy that converts verifier rewards into per-seed environment-synthesis actions. Envs-FORGE estimates seed pass rates, scores six projection--direction actions around a target learning frontier, and solves a per-seed mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to choose the action that conditions generation. The selected action drives synchronized rewriting of the instruction, fixtures, oracle solution, tests, and Docker environment; only gold-verified bundles enter RL training. The indexed MILP form also supports optional soft skill coverage for portfolio planning. On Qwen 3.5 3

translated_title: Envs-FORGE：面向智能体强化学习的前沿优化与奖励基础环境合成
translated_abstract: 针对终端智能体的强化学习（RL）需要具有可靠奖励和有用难度的可执行训练环境。固定配方（如少样本、Self-Instruct和Evol-Instruct）对每个种子应用相同的提示策略，即使当前策略可能从更难、更简单或仅仅是不同的任务中获益。我们提出了Envs-FORGE，一种将验证器奖励转换为每个种子环境合成动作的提示策略。Envs-FORGE估计种子通过率，围绕目标学习前沿评估六个投影方向动作，并求解每个种子的混合整数线性规划（MILP）以选择调节生成的动作。所选动作驱动指令、固定装置、神谕解决方案、测试和Docker环境的同步重写；只有经过黄金验证的包才能进入RL训练。索引MILP形式还支持组合规划中的可选软技能覆盖。在Qwen 3.5 3上进行了实验。
tldr: Envs-FORGE提出了一种基于验证器奖励和混合整数线性规划的动态环境合成策略，通过前沿优化选择每个种子的最佳生成动作，仅使用黄金验证的包进行强化学习训练，显著提升了终端智能体的学习效率。
en_tdlr: Envs-FORGE introduces a frontier-optimized, reward-grounded environment synthesis strategy that uses per-seed MILP-based action selection to dynamically generate training environments, ensuring only gold-verified bundles enter RL training, thereby improving agent learning efficiency.
